subject: AXUIElement identity of track headers across a Logic sort
question: Do the track-header elements move with their rows when Logic reorders tracks?

reverify.expected: after a sort that moves rows, every after-element is CFEqual to the before-element at the SAME index
reverify.cost: needs 3+ tracks whose creation order differs from their name order; ~1 min

method: Read the track-header rail's AXLayoutItem children and their AXDescriptions, drove a sort through Logic's own Track > Sort Tracks by menu, re-read, then matched every after-element to the before-elements with CFEqual.
conclusion: Logic keeps the same AXUIElement objects at the same rail positions and swaps their CONTENT. Element 0 held Bravo before and Yankee after. A join on element identity therefore returns the identity permutation for every sort, which is why sort_verified's after_order always equalled before_order and State A was unreachable.
limits: Three tracks, one sort criterion (creation date). Not swept across criteria or larger arrangements.
Says nothing about element identity across operations other than sorting.
